notes.title: Grand update of the game page
notes.content:
Welcome tower defenders!

We worked hard and created almost all of the starter content:
- 4 biomes
- 18 missions
- tons of fun emotions and achievements
- 10 extravagant towers
- many creatures and buildings

In this regard, we have updated the look of the game page.

We're polishing and balancing the gameplay while you enjoy the new look for the game page.

One month left before the release!
